summary: Resource cleanup driven by type flags. When bit 0 or bit 1 of the flags at this+0x00 is set, the raw pointer at this+0x18 is freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf and zeroed. Independently of the flags, a non-null pointer at this+0x14 is released through ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease(dword_8B78A0, this+0x14), freed if it survives the reset, and zeroed. Ends with a call to EmptyStub_0170. Called from ResourceCascadeCleanup.

local_names.this: resource object whose flag word and two resource slots are cleaned
local_names.dword_8B78A0: global passed as the first argument of ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease

operations.description: Proceed to the offset 0x18 cleanup only when bit 0 or bit 1 of the flag word at this+0x00 is set
Within the flag block, free the secondary resource slot only when the pointer at this+0x18 is non-null
Free the pointer at this+0x18 through the FreeWrapper_7bcf memory free wrapper
Process the primary slot only when the pointer at this+0x14 is non-null
After the reset, free the primary slot again only if the pointer at this+0x14 is still non-null
Free the pointer at this+0x14 through the FreeWrapper_7bcf memory free wrapper
Invoke EmptyStub_0170() as the final step of the routine
Returns void; invoked from the ResourceCascadeCleanup teardown path
